methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Furthermore, a qualitative hypothesis test is carried out on the individual technologies. The EEP of the 11 cross-sectional technologies is compared with every other technology on the basis of the evaluated frequencies. If the EEP of businesses with EnMS is lower than that of businesses with EMS, the hypothesis can be confirmed. The hypothesis is rejected if the potential is equal to or greater than 1.
